photos.desc: Timurlengia euotica rear neck vertebra (USNM 538131) on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of Natural History.
Tooth of the new tyrannosaur Timurlengia euotica, catalog number 538157, from the Late Cretaceous Period that was found in the Kyzylkum Desert, Uzbekistan.
3D-printed cast of the Timurlengia euotica holotypic braincase (ZIN PH 1146/16) on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of Natural History.
